title: Construction Materials — DPP characteristics
description: Field specifications for the Construction Materials Digital Product Passport, shaped for UNTP's credentialSubject.characteristics extension point. Economic operators and facility identifiers are carried by the UNTP envelope and are deliberately absent here.

productTypeModelIdentifier.title: Product Type / Model Identifier
productTypeModelIdentifier.description: GTIN identifying the product type or model

batchLotNumber.title: Batch / Lot Number
batchLotNumber.description: Batch or lot number per GS1 AI 10
batchLotNumber.x-provision: GPSR (EU) 2023/988 Art. 9(5) — type, batch, serial number or other identifying element
batchLotNumber.x-citationNote: GPSR Art. 9(5) is satisfied by any one identifying element, so a batch number is not separately mandated where a unique product identifier is present.

serialNumber.title: Serial Number
serialNumber.description: Individual item serial number, optional per delegated act
serialNumber.x-citationNote: GPSR Art. 9(5) is satisfied by ANY ONE identifying element — type, batch, serial number or other — marked on the product. Where a unique product identifier is already present, a serial number is not separately mandated.

placeOfManufacture.title: Place of Manufacture
placeOfManufacture.description: Location (city/country) where the product was manufactured
placeOfManufacture.x-citationNote: No EU instrument in force requires publishing the place of manufacture; GPSR Art. 9(6) requires the manufacturer's address, not the factory location.

productFamily.title: Product Family
productFamily.description: Product family classification per CPR Annex VII (36 families)
productFamily.x-provision: CPR (EU) 2024/3110 Annex VII — product-family taxonomy for harmonised technical specifications
productFamily.x-citationNote: The Annex VII family taxonomy scopes harmonised specifications; it is not a standalone disclosure duty.

mechanicalResistanceStability.title: Mechanical Resistance & Stability
mechanicalResistanceStability.description: Compressive strength, tensile strength, and load-bearing capacity per Annex I basic requirement 1
mechanicalResistanceStability.x-provision: CPR (EU) 2024/3110 Art. 13 — declared in the Declaration of Performance, where a harmonised technical specification covers the characteristic
mechanicalResistanceStability.x-citationNote: Declared in the Declaration of Performance for characteristics covered by a harmonised technical specification; the CPR passport duty is deferred pending the Art. 75(1) delegated act.

fireSafety.title: Fire Safety
fireSafety.description: Euroclass reaction to fire (A1-F), fire resistance (REI), and external fire performance per Annex I basic requirement 2
fireSafety.x-provision: CPR (EU) 2024/3110 Art. 13 — declared in the Declaration of Performance, where a harmonised technical specification covers the characteristic
fireSafety.x-citationNote: Declared in the Declaration of Performance for characteristics covered by a harmonised technical specification; the CPR passport duty is deferred pending the Art. 75(1) delegated act.

hygieneHealthEnvironment.title: Hygiene, Health & Environment
hygieneHealthEnvironment.description: Dangerous substance release, water permeability per Annex I basic requirement 3
hygieneHealthEnvironment.x-provision: CPR (EU) 2024/3110 Art. 13 — declared in the Declaration of Performance, where a harmonised technical specification covers the characteristic
hygieneHealthEnvironment.x-citationNote: Declared in the Declaration of Performance for characteristics covered by a harmonised technical specification; the CPR passport duty is deferred pending the Art. 75(1) delegated act.

safetyAccessibility.title: Safety & Accessibility
safetyAccessibility.description: Slip resistance and impact resistance per Annex I basic requirement 4
safetyAccessibility.x-provision: CPR (EU) 2024/3110 Art. 13 — declared in the Declaration of Performance, where a harmonised technical specification covers the characteristic
safetyAccessibility.x-citationNote: Declared in the Declaration of Performance for characteristics covered by a harmonised technical specification; the CPR passport duty is deferred pending the Art. 75(1) delegated act.

noiseProtection.title: Noise Protection
noiseProtection.description: Sound absorption and airborne sound insulation per Annex I basic requirement 5
noiseProtection.x-provision: CPR (EU) 2024/3110 Art. 13 — declared in the Declaration of Performance, where a harmonised technical specification covers the characteristic
noiseProtection.x-citationNote: Declared in the Declaration of Performance for characteristics covered by a harmonised technical specification; the CPR passport duty is deferred pending the Art. 75(1) delegated act.

energyHeat.title: Energy / Heat
energyHeat.description: Thermal conductivity (lambda) and thermal resistance (R-value) per Annex I basic requirement 6
energyHeat.x-provision: CPR (EU) 2024/3110 Art. 13 — declared in the Declaration of Performance, where a harmonised technical specification covers the characteristic
energyHeat.x-citationNote: Declared in the Declaration of Performance for characteristics covered by a harmonised technical specification; the CPR passport duty is deferred pending the Art. 75(1) delegated act.

sustainableUseNaturalResources.title: Sustainable Use of Natural Resources
sustainableUseNaturalResources.description: Durability, recyclability, secondary materials content, and LCA data per Annex I basic requirement 7 (NEW in revised CPR)
sustainableUseNaturalResources.x-provision: CPR (EU) 2024/3110 Art. 13 — declared in the Declaration of Performance, where a harmonised technical specification covers the characteristic
sustainableUseNaturalResources.x-citationNote: Declared in the Declaration of Performance for characteristics covered by a harmonised technical specification; the CPR passport duty is deferred pending the Art. 75(1) delegated act.

gwpTotal.title: GWP-total (Climate Change)
gwpTotal.description: Total global warming potential including fossil, biogenic, and land use components

gwpFossil.title: GWP-fossil
gwpFossil.description: Global warming potential from fossil fuel sources

gwpBiogenic.title: GWP-biogenic
gwpBiogenic.description: Global warming potential from biogenic carbon sources

gwpLuluc.title: GWP-luluc (Land Use)
gwpLuluc.description: Global warming potential from land use and land use change
gwpLuluc.x-standard: EN 15804+A2 (global warming potential, land use and land-use change)

ap.title: AP (Acidification)
ap.description: Acidification potential of soil and water

adpeMinerals.title: ADPE (Abiotic Depletion — Minerals)
adpeMinerals.description: Abiotic depletion potential for minerals and metals
adpeMinerals.x-standard: EN 15804+A2 (abiotic depletion potential, minerals and metals)

adpfFossil.title: ADPF (Abiotic Depletion — Fossil)
adpfFossil.description: Abiotic depletion potential for fossil resources

lifeCycleModules.title: Life Cycle Modules
lifeCycleModules.description: Life cycle stages covered: A1-A3 mandatory, C1-C4 and Module D mandatory under EN 15804+A2
lifeCycleModules.x-standard: EN 15804+A2 (life-cycle module definitions A1-A3, C1-C4, D)

recycledContent.title: Recycled Content
recycledContent.description: Percentage of recycled material content in the product
recycledContent.x-provision: CPR (EU) 2024/3110 Art. 13 — declared in the Declaration of Performance, where a harmonised technical specification covers the characteristic
recycledContent.x-citationNote: Declared in the Declaration of Performance for characteristics covered by a harmonised technical specification; the CPR passport duty is deferred pending the Art. 75(1) delegated act.

substancesOfConcern.title: Substances of Concern
substancesOfConcern.description: Substances of concern per REACH/SCIP with CAS numbers
substancesOfConcern.x-provision: REACH (EC) 1907/2006 Art. 33(1) — on request, above 0.1% w/w, minimum content the substance name
substancesOfConcern.x-citationNote: REACH Art. 33 is an on-request duty above 0.1% w/w, answered with at minimum the substance name; SCIP notification to ECHA is the database side. Neither is discharged by publishing here.

durabilityServiceLife.title: Durability / Service Life
durabilityServiceLife.description: Expected service life in years or durability class
durabilityServiceLife.x-provision: CPR (EU) 2024/3110 Art. 13 — declared in the Declaration of Performance, where a harmonised technical specification covers the characteristic
durabilityServiceLife.x-citationNote: Declared in the Declaration of Performance for characteristics covered by a harmonised technical specification; the CPR passport duty is deferred pending the Art. 75(1) delegated act.

repairReuseInstructions.title: Repair / Reuse Instructions
repairReuseInstructions.description: Instructions and guidance for repair and reuse of the product
repairReuseInstructions.x-citationNote: No EU instrument in force requires repair or reuse instructions for construction products; the CPR provisions that would are deferred.

endOfLifeInstructions.title: End-of-Life / Demolition Instructions
endOfLifeInstructions.description: Instructions for end-of-life treatment and demolition/deconstruction
endOfLifeInstructions.x-citationNote: No EU instrument in force mandates demolition or end-of-life guidance for construction products.

recyclabilityAssessment.title: Recyclability Assessment
recyclabilityAssessment.description: Recyclability assessment per EN 15804 Module D

packagingEnvironmentalAnalysis.title: Packaging Environmental Analysis
packagingEnvironmentalAnalysis.description: Environmental analysis of product packaging materials and recyclability
packagingEnvironmentalAnalysis.x-citationNote: The CPR's environmental duties run through the Declaration of Performance for characteristics covered by a harmonised technical specification, and the packaging of a construction product is governed by PPWR rather than the CPR. No in-force provision requires a packaging environmental analysis as passport data.

ceMarkingStatus.title: CE Marking Status
ceMarkingStatus.description: Whether the product bears CE marking and its validity CE marking is affixed to the product or its packaging and is obligatory only where a harmonised specification or ETA covers the product.
ceMarkingStatus.x-provision: CPR (EU) 2024/3110 Arts. 13-17 — CE marking, only where a harmonised technical specification or a European Technical Assessment covers the product
ceMarkingStatus.x-citationNote: CE marking under the CPR is CONDITIONAL: it applies only where a harmonised technical specification or a European Technical Assessment covers the product, and a product covered by neither cannot be CE-marked at all. The duty is to affix the mark and draw up the Declaration of Performance behind it, not to publish a status flag.

avcpSystemLevel.title: AVCP System Level
avcpSystemLevel.description: Assessment and Verification of Constancy of Performance system level
avcpSystemLevel.x-provision: CPR (EU) 2024/3110 Art. 13 + Annex IX — AVCP system stated in the Declaration of Performance
avcpSystemLevel.x-citationNote: The AVCP system is recorded in the Declaration of Performance, not published as a passport field.

notifiedBodyNameNumber.title: Notified Body Name and Number
notifiedBodyNameNumber.description: Name and identification number of the Notified Body involved in conformity assessment
notifiedBodyNameNumber.x-provision: CPR (EU) 2024/3110 Art. 13 — notified body identified in the Declaration of Performance
notifiedBodyNameNumber.x-citationNote: The notified body's name and number appear in the Declaration of Performance and alongside the CE marking.

testReportReferences.title: Test / Assessment Report References
testReportReferences.description: URIs or references to test and assessment reports
testReportReferences.x-provision: CPR (EU) 2024/3110 Art. 22 — technical documentation held and produced to authorities on request
testReportReferences.x-citationNote: Test and assessment reports are technical-file content produced on request, not published.

epdVerification.title: EPD Verification
epdVerification.description: Third-party Environmental Product Declaration verification, required for AVCP 3+ (NEW in revised CPR)
epdVerification.x-citationNote: Environmental product declarations under EN 15804+A2 are voluntary; no EU instrument in force mandates one.

harmonizedStandardReference.title: Harmonized Standard Reference
harmonizedStandardReference.description: Reference to the applicable harmonized European standard (hEN)
harmonizedStandardReference.x-provision: CPR (EU) 2024/3110 Art. 13 — harmonised technical specification cited in the Declaration of Performance
harmonizedStandardReference.x-citationNote: The applicable harmonised standard is cited in the Declaration of Performance, which is the instrument discharging the duty.

eadReference.title: EAD Reference
eadReference.description: European Assessment Document reference, if no harmonized standard exists
eadReference.x-citationNote: A European Assessment Document underpins a European Technical Assessment, which a manufacturer requests voluntarily where no harmonised standard covers the product. Obtaining an ETA is a choice; referencing the EAD is not a mandated disclosure.

installationInstructions.title: Installation Instructions
installationInstructions.description: Instructions for proper installation of the construction product
installationInstructions.x-provision: GPSR (EU) 2023/988 Art. 9(7) — instructions and safety information, where the product's risks require them
installationInstructions.x-citationNote: GPSR requires instructions accompany the product where safety requires it; it is not unconditional for every construction product.

maintenanceGuidance.title: Maintenance Guidance
maintenanceGuidance.description: Guidance on maintenance and care of the product during its service life
maintenanceGuidance.x-citationNote: No EU instrument in force requires maintenance guidance for construction products.

safetyDataLabelling.title: Safety Data / Hazardous Substance Labelling
safetyDataLabelling.description: Safety data sheet references and hazardous substance labelling information
safetyDataLabelling.x-provision: CLP (EC) 1272/2008 Arts. 17-19 — hazard label on the product; REACH Art. 31 — safety data sheet supplied to recipients
safetyDataLabelling.x-citationNote: Hazard communication is discharged by the physical CLP label and the safety data sheet supplied down the chain.

warrantyInformation.title: Warranty Information
warrantyInformation.description: Product warranty details including duration and coverage
warrantyInformation.x-citationNote: A commercial warranty is a contractual matter. The CPR requires the Declaration of Performance, not warranty terms, and no in-force construction provision makes warranty information passport data.

intendedUseDescription.title: Intended Use Description
intendedUseDescription.description: Description of the intended use(s) of the construction product
intendedUseDescription.x-provision: GPSR (EU) 2023/988 Art. 9(7) — information enabling assessment of the product's risks in its intended and reasonably foreseeable use

ceMarking.title: CE Marking
ceMarking.description: Whether the battery bears the CE marking
ceMarking.x-citationNote: The CE mark is affixed to the product; the obligation is discharged by that mark and by the Declaration of Performance supporting it, and only where a harmonised technical specification or an ETA covers the product.
